The eighth public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork, for test servers ahead of a stable release. It replaces RC7.

### Action required

Update an existing RC7 test VM before its next maintenance window. The installer is now v1.59 and its daily heal migrates a seeded fail-open CrowdSec bouncer config to the fail-closed posture on the next run; opt out once with `touch /data/crowdsec/keep-fail-open`. Nothing else is manual - the TOTP replay migration runs on its own.

### Security

- Closed four findings of the September 16 security-quality audit and six of the CrowdSec integration audit.
- A delegated manager can no longer attach another user's access list by guessing its id.
- Permission checks fail closed on malformed permission strings and anonymous-session sentinels.
- Changing a local-path host's fastcgi target port now trips the admin-only privilege guard.
- Unix-socket and custom upstream destinations, including custom locations and stream upstreams, are administrators-only.
- Access-list addresses and auth-request upstreams that are not plain addresses are rejected from delegated managers.
- CrowdSec is fail-closed end to end: the image seeds `MODE=stream` with `APPSEC_FAILURE_ACTION=deny`, key files are written race-free, and the daily heal reopens the public gate only after the firewall bouncer is enforcing.
- An AppSec outage under `deny` no longer serves the ban page as HTTP 200; patched in the pinned bouncer source until upstream [lua-cs-bouncer#159](https://github.com/crowdsecurity/lua-cs-bouncer/pull/159) is included.
- `deny` without `FALLBACK_REMEDIATION` no longer lets every request through; the heal seeds it and the doctor flags it.
- TOTP codes are single-use, including under concurrent logins, and existing enrollments keep their secrets.
- Access-list usernames containing htpasswd delimiters or control characters are rejected, and malformed legacy records are skipped when the auth file is regenerated.

### Changed

- Attackers is the default CrowdSec view: paginated source-IP groups, searchable observations, bounded older-history loading, and an investigation drawer whose evidence loads on demand. See the [investigation guidance](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/blob/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.8/docs/attacker-investigation.md).
- Reconciled upstream `develop` through `fce815df`: certificate ids a caller cannot see are rejected on create and update, and new non-admin users default to `hidden` on every resource.
- nginx moves to 1.31.6 with aws-lc v5.9.0; dependency bumps are taken only after the 7-day supply-chain gate.

### Fixed

- Bouncer identity is reported with the fork's user agent instead of being relabelled by the LAPI.
- Every LAPI reader answers a stable 502 instead of an unhandled 500.
- Attacker-influenced counter keys can no longer seed a bogus insight row.
- Browser notifications dedupe on stable per-type signal ids and re-fire after a cleared condition.
- The refresh and pager buttons respond to clicks during background polls.
- The ASN quick-filter chips use the documented field token.
- Log lines that a timer repeats are reported once per outage instead of once per tick.
- A deliberately switched-off nginx observation source reports `disabled` instead of `unavailable`.

### Upgrade

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.8/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.8/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed one. Safe update repairs known configuration drift before the normal snapshot, health check, and automatic rollback protection.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
